why: Each row has one circle, one triangle and one square as the outer shape, one of each as the small inner shape, and one black, one white and one hatched inner shape. Row 3 still needs an outer triangle with a small black square, which is option 6. Option 2 is a triangle with a square too, but its square is hatched, and row 3 already has a hatched shape.
trick: Check three things separately: outer shape, inner shape and shading. Each must appear once in every row.
